answer_1.outputs: captions and commonsense descriptions (intention, effect, attribute)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method using BLEU (n=1-4) , Meteor , Rouge , and perplexity score of the generation on its corpus.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluations using AMT workers, who are asked to identity whether the generated commonsense justifiably completes the events.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate on a scale of 1 to 5 based on relevance to the video and plausibility of completing the event.
